utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon to you all. The court is in session. Registrar, can you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-82-A, the Prosecutor versus Ljube Boskoski and Johan Tarculovski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Tarculovski, can you hear and follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT TARCULOVSKI: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You may sit down. Can we have the appearances, please, starting with the representatives of the OTP, please. MS. MARTIN SALGADO: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Elena Martin Salgado. I'm appearing on behalf of the Prosecution and with me is appeals counsel, Paul Rogers, and case manager, Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Ms. Salgado. Let me turn to the representatives of Mr. Boskoski's Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Guenael Mettraux assisted by Mr. Sulejman Imsirpasic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Mettraux. Let me now turn to the representatives of Mr. Tarculovski's Defence. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Nathan Dershowitz and Antonio Apostolski on behalf of Mr. Johan Tarculovski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [No interpretation] [Interpretation] -- within 120 days after the filing of the notice of appeal. This Status Conference has been convened in accordance with Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal, that requires a Status Conference to be held within 120 days of the filing of the notice of appeal. For technical reasons, I shall repeat. As you know, this Status Conference has been convened in accordance with Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, that requires a Status Conference to be held within 120 days of the filing of the notice of appeal, and thereafter within 120 days after the last Status Conference. The main purpose of a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. We met for the first time on the 1st of December, 2008. Let me recall that the Trial Chamber handed down its judgement in this case on the 10th of July, 2008. Let me also remind you that the OTP filed its notice of appeal on the 6th of August, 2008, and Mr. Tarculovski's Defence filed its notice of appeal on the 8th of August, 2008. I would now like to address the conditions in detention and the state of health of Mr. Tarculovski. Mr. Tarculovski, would you like to address any concerns you may have concerning your conditions in detention or your state of health? THE APPELLANT TARCULOVSKI: [Interpretation] No, I have no problems, Your Honour. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may sit down. I shall remind you of the schedule for the filing of submissions on appeal. The OTP filed its confidential appeals brief on the 20th of October, 2008, as well as a redacted version of this brief on the 3rd of November and a redacted version that was corrected and which was filed on the 4th of November, 2008. Mr. Boskoski's Defence filed its brief in response on the 1st of December, 2008. And the OTP filed its brief in reply on the 16th of December, 2008. I note also that Mr. Tarculovski's Defence filed his appeals brief, his confidential appeals brief, on the 9th of January, 2009, as well as a redacted version of this brief on the 12th of January, 2009. The Appeals Chamber is currently seized of the pending motions filed by the parties. It will hand down its decision in due course. Furthermore, let me remind you that pursuant to the decision handed down by the Appeals Chamber on the 18th of February, 2008, at the request of the OTP for an extension of the time-limit to file its brief in response as follows: This will be filed 14 days after the Appeals Chamber has handed down its decision on the pending motions filed by Mr. Tarculovski asking for leave to amend his notice of appeal filed on the 12th of January, 2009, as well as the OTP's request to have two of the grounds of appeal of Mr. Tarculovski's appeals brief filed on the 22nd of January, 2009, dropped. Once all the submissions have been filed, the Appeals Chamber will then decide how to proceed and will set the date of the appeals hearing. I would, however, like to ask the parties if at this stage they have any questions they would like to address at this -- at this Status Conference. Let me now turn to the representatives of the OTP. MS. MARTIN SALGADO: Your Honour, we don't have any issues to raise at this point. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mrs. Martin Salgado. Defence counsel of Mr. Tarculovski, would you like to address anything in particular? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: The only question is trying to figure out a schedule knowing that decisions will come down in due course and just trying, in a vague sort of way, to have some idea as to whether there is a chance that the argument will take place prior to the break or whether we should anticipate that it will be argued after the break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you, counsel. I took note of what you have just been saying, and I can assure you that the Chamber will do its best to accelerate the process. Thank you. [Interpretation] Let me now turn to Mr. Boskoski's Defence counsel. Do you wish to address any particular issue at this juncture.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. You have given an answer to our question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Mettraux. As far as I'm concerned, I have no other issue to raise. I believe, therefore, that we can adjourn the hearing for today. I would like to thank the parties for having attended this Status Conference as well as staff members of this Tribunal and for having helped us organise this Status Conference. The court stands adjourned.
